title: ExtendScript runtime Reflection versus documentation
question: Which scripting member names are visible through runtime Reflection for representative AE objects, and how does that observed set compare with the current scripting documentation inventory?

environment.notes: Captured by the same single user-run JSX used for AEIG 1.0 core experiments.

hypotheses.prediction: Runtime Reflection and documentation overlap substantially but are not identical.
hypotheses.falsified_by: All seven representative objects expose exactly the same member-name sets as the documentation corpus.

procedure: User runs experiments/user-run/AEIG-1.0-L5/01_RUN_IN_AE.jsx once in the disposable session.
The script dumps Reflection property/method metadata for representative runtime objects before and during the controlled fixture.
analyze_scripting_reflection.py compares member names against the current scripting-docs atlas without treating either side as an authoritative superset.

result.conclusion: Runtime Reflection capture parsed and compared with the scripting documentation atlas.
